CHAPTER.VERS: Praise YAH! Praise, O servants of Jehovah, praise the name of Jehovah!
Blessed is the name of Jehovah from this time forth and forevermore!
From the rising of the sun to its going down Jehovahs name is to be praised.
Jehovah is high above all nations, His glory above the heavens.
Who is like Jehovah our God, who dwells on high,
who humbles Himself to behold the things that are in the heavens and in the earth!
He raises the poor out of the dust, and lifts the needy out of the ash heap,
that He may seat him with nobles; with the nobles of His people.
He causes the barren to dwell in a house, like a joyful mother of children. Praise YAH!
